6430.head: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
6430.story: Butler, who underwent surgery after suffering the injury Jan. 19, has progressed to individual court work but still has several rehabilitation milestones to clear. His next step involves landing comfortably after a game-speed jump. Coach Steve Kerr is hopeful Butler can rejoin Golden State for the latter portion of the season, though no official return date has been announced. The 37-year-old forward remains a significant part of the Warriors' plans and could provide a substantial boost during the second half of the campaign.
6430.zh: 右膝 ACL 撕裂術後復健中，球團預估 1 到 2 月回歸，已開始個人球場訓練。

6440.head: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.
6440.story: Harris suffered a strained left calf ahead of the 2026-27 campaign and has yet to make his debut with the Spurs. The veteran is slowly making progress toward a return, though he should be considered week-to-week until more information is released. The 34-year-old, who signed with San Antonio during the offseason, averaged 13.3 points, 5.1 rebounds and 2.5 assists over 27.7 minutes per contest in 63 regular-season appearances with the Pistons in 2025-26.
6440.zh: 左小腿拉傷，賽季前就受傷還沒出賽，週六對灰狼確定缺陣，以週為單位觀察。

6450.head: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
6450.story: Leonard will now begin the next phase of his rehab, and while he'll be re-evaluated by Nov. 10, it's still unlikely we'll see him back on the floor until the end of November. Ja'Kobe Walter should continue to start while Leonard is sidelined, and it'll be Scottie Barnes, Immanuel Quickley and RJ Barrett running the show on offense.
6450.zh: 左膝積水處理完成，11/10 前重新評估，預計 11 月底才會回場。

6580.head: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
6580.story: Beal is dealing with knee inflammation that will keep him sidelined for Opening Night. While it's unclear how long the Clippers will be without the veteran guard, Darius Garland, Keaton Wagler and Kris Dunn should dominate the backcourt minutes in his absence. Beal's 2025-26 campaign was cut short by a hip injury after he averaged 8.2 points and 1.7 assists in 20.6 minutes across just six regular-season appearances.
6580.zh: 膝蓋發炎，無法趕上開季，何時回來未定。

6583.head: Davis (ankle) won't play Saturday against the Thunder.
6583.story: This will be Davis' second straight game on the sidelines, which could result in another start for Deandre Ayton and extended minutes for Bilal Coulibaly. Davis' next chance to play will come Monday in Detroit.
6583.zh: 腳踝傷，週六對雷霆確定缺陣，已連續缺兩場，下一次機會是週一對活塞。

2991235.head: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
2991235.story: Adams hasn't played since Oct. 23 due to a right soleus strain and remains without a definitive timetable to return. Oscar Tshiebwe figures to see increased burn until Capela (ankle) or Adams returns.
2991235.zh: 右小腿比目魚肌拉傷（10/23 起），沒有回歸時間，每週評估一次。

3032979.head: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.
3032979.story: Schroder is sitting out Friday for the first time this season due to left thigh soreness. With the veteran floor general sidelined, Coby White should see his minutes climb into the 20s for the first time this year as he works back from a preseason calf strain.
3032979.zh: 左大腿痠痛，週五對塞爾提克缺陣，是本季第一次缺賽。

3059318.head: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.
3059318.story: Embiid continues to work through plantar fasciitis in his right foot. Philadelphia has kept their star center on an injury management routine, and with Embiid being listed as probable to suit up versus Chicago, he's likely to be active and reprise his starting role for the 8-2 76ers.
3059318.zh: 右腳足底筋膜炎，週日對公牛列 probable，應該會上場。

3062679.head: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.
3062679.story: Hart practiced Friday, per Steve Popper of Newsday, but he's getting a bit more time to recover. Landry Shamet should draw a second consecutive start for the Knicks on Saturday.
3062679.zh: 右腳踝痠痛，週六對騎士確定缺陣，週五有參加練習。

3102529.head: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.
3102529.story: The veteran big man is managing a sprained right ankle, which is costing him a third consecutive contest. His next chance to return arrives Monday, when the Rockets host the Nuggets.
3102529.zh: 右腳踝扭傷，週六對太陽確定缺陣，已連續缺 3 場，下一次機會是週一對金塊。

3102530.head: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
3102530.story: Nurkic is progressing in his recovery, but the two-week re-evaluation timeline indicates he remains some distance from returning to game action. His absence should continue to create opportunities in Utah's frontcourt, with Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba among the players positioned to benefit from additional playing time. Nurkic's next evaluation will provide a clearer picture of his potential return date.
3102530.zh: 右腳傷（腳趾），已開始場上活動，兩週後重新評估，離回場還有一段距離。

3102531.head: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
3102531.story: Porzingis said he was looking forward to joining the Warriors, but his body didn't respond the way he wanted it too during his ramp-up process before the season. Additionally, he said he will work with the Warriors on a solution that "makes sense." Porzingis is making this decision to prioritize his health and will hopefully turn a corner soon on that front.
3102531.zh: 在社群媒體宣布暫時離開籃球，賽季前的恢復過程身體反應不如預期，將和勇士討論解決方案。

3146557.head: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.
3146557.story: It's the fourth game in a row that Landale will miss as he continues to recover from a left hip strain. His next chance to return to the court will come Monday against the Lakers.
3146557.zh: 左髖拉傷，週六對籃網確定缺陣，已連續缺 4 場，下一次機會是週一對湖人。

3907387.head: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
3907387.story: Simmons had a quality preseason, averaging 10.5 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists over 17.4 minutes per contest (two games). The 30-year-old was on track to suit up for the Kings on opening night, though those plans were halted after he suffered a torn Achilles tendon during practice. Now, Simmons will focus on rehab. However, it's unknown what the future holds regarding his career in the NBA.
3907387.zh: 右腳阿基里斯腱撕裂，已完成手術，長期缺陣。

3913176.head: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
3913176.story: Ingram hasn't played yet this season. While the veteran is reportedly moving in a positive direction, he won't make his 2026-27 campaign debut Sunday versus his former team. Ingram's next opportunity to suit up will come Tuesday in Phoenix. In the meantime, Darius Garland will remain the Clippers' No. 1 scoring option.
3913176.zh: 阿基里斯腱傷，週日對鵜鶘不上場，本季還沒出賽，但復原方向正面。

3934673.head: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
3934673.story: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.
3934673.zh: 右腳阿基里斯腱撕裂（季後賽第一輪）已近六個月，仍有信心本季回歸，正在復健。

3945274.head: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.
3945274.story: Doncic dropped his second 50-piece of the season during Friday's 124-118 win over Portland, but the Lakers' superstar is dealing with tightness in his lower back that will leave his status for Sunday's outing up in the air. If Doncic is unable to suit up, Austin Reaves will take over primary offensive responsibilities while Quentin Grimes and Collin Sexton would see a substantial increase in minutes for the first night of LA's back-to-back set.
3945274.zh: 下背緊繃，週日對活塞列 questionable，週五剛拿 50 分。

4065654.head: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.
4065654.story: Isaac was assigned to Osceola but recalled again on the same day while he continued his recovery from a knee issue. Having yet to play this season, the forward is not expected to find a meaningful role in the short term, and he'll likely appear on the bench when he's available again.
4065654.zh: 膝傷，已從發展聯盟召回，本季還沒出賽，回來後預計不會有重要角色。

4066211.head: Williams (rest) won't play in Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4066211.story: Williams logged 16 minutes in Friday's 124-118 loss to the Lakers, though he won't play Saturday versus San Antonio, the second game of a back-to-back for Portland. As a result, Branden Carlson and Yang Hansen should each receive more playing time behind Donovan Clingan.
4066211.zh: 背靠背第二場輪休，週六對馬刺不上場。

4066218.head: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.
4066218.story: Williams has yet to make his season debut due to a right hamstring strain. However, he appears to be making progress after joining the Swarm for practice Wednesday.
4066218.zh: 右大腿後肌拉傷，已從發展聯盟召回並開始練球，還沒本季首戰。

4066320.head: Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.
4066320.story: Bane will miss Saturday night's contest in Golden State with an illness. He joins Paolo Banchero (ankle) and Jalen Suggs (knee) on the sidelines, as the Magic now have 60 percent of their opening night starting lineup donning street clothes. Bane's next chance to suit up will come Tuesday versus the Kings. In his absence, expect Jase Richardson, Jamal Cain and Jevon Carter to absorb extra minutes.
4066320.zh: 生病，週六對勇士確定缺陣。

4066328.head: Allen (knee) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks
4066328.story: Allen missed Friday's game against the 76ers and will also miss the second leg of the back-to-back set against the reigning champions. This means Evan Mobley will continue to start at center, with Mario Hezonja probably entering the lineup at one of the two forward spots. Allen's next chance to play will come against the Hornets on Monday.
4066328.zh: 膝傷，連續缺陣，週六對尼克也確定缺陣。

4066336.head: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.
4066336.story: Markkanen initially injured his wrist Oct. 26 against the Grizzlies, and although he has played in four games since then, he may be at risk of sitting out Sunday's contest. Josh Green could get another look in the starting lineup if Markkanen is unable to play.
4066336.zh: 右手腕扭傷，週日對灰狼列 questionable。

4066650.head: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
4066650.story: Collins left Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks with an illness, then missed Friday's practice due to the ailment. He's battling a respiratory issue that will force him to miss his third contest of the season. Noa Essengue, Leonard Miller and Patrick Williams could all see additional minutes versus the 76ers with Collins out.
4066650.zh: 生病（呼吸道），週日對七六人確定缺陣，第三次缺賽。

4066757.head: Merrill (elbow) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
4066757.story: Merrill exited Friday's game against the 76ers due to an elbow injury, and the Cavaliers are taking a cautious approach with him since he already missed time in the preseason with a right elbow problem. Meleek Thomas, Mario Hezonja and Tyrese Proctor could see more playing time with Merrill sidelined Saturday.
4066757.zh: 手肘傷，週六對尼克確定缺陣，球團採保守處理。

4277961.head: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4277961.story: Jackson sustained the injury early in Monday's loss to Memphis, and he's now expected to miss at least a month and a half of action. The star big man's absence creates a major void in the Utah lineup, one that is likely to be filled by a timeshare of Jaxson Hayes (shoulder), Kyle Filipowski and Mo Bamba. The Jazz could also shift Lauri Markkanen (wrist), when healthy, to the center spot at times, perhaps allowing Ace Bailey to spend more time at power forward.
4277961.zh: 右膝 MCL 撕裂，預計缺陣 6 到 8 週。

4278067.head: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.
4278067.story: Collins was originally marked as probable for Sunday's contest, but he appears to be trending in the wrong direction as game day approaches. If Claxton needs to sit out another game, Jalen Smith (hand) would presumably continue to operate as the Bulls' starting center.
4278067.zh: 大腿後肌，週日對七六人從 probable 降為 questionable，首度登場可能延後。

4278129.head: Ayton won't return to Saturday's game against the Thunder due to a lower leg injury.
4278129.story: Ayton will end his evening with two points (1-2 FG), one rebound and one turnover in seven minutes. For now, he should be considered questionable for Monday's game in Detroit.
4278129.zh: 小腿傷，週六對雷霆中途退場，週一對活塞列 questionable。

4278402.head: Goodwin (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Rockets.
4278402.story: Goodwin will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left calf injury. Collin Gillespie and Luke Kennard should remain heavily involved off the bench for the Suns.
4278402.zh: 左小腿傷，週六對火箭確定缺陣，已連續缺 3 場。

4279888.head: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
4279888.story: Morant was initially given a four-week timetable after he suffered a Grade 2 left hamstring strain on Oct. 30. It sounds like he's making solid progress, though it would be surprising to see him beat that timetable given the tricky nature of hamstring injuries. Scoot Henderson will continue to start in his absence and there will be more minutes available for Jrue Holiday.
4279888.zh: 左大腿後肌 Grade 2 拉傷，醫生看法正面，教練說可能不用缺原本預估的 4 週那麼久。

4395702.head: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.
4395702.story: Joe is still bothered by the right hip contusion he suffered against the 76ers on Oct. 25, and it will cause him to miss a sixth consecutive game Sunday. He'll have another chance to return to action Monday against Washington.
4395702.zh: 右髖挫傷，週日對湖人確定缺陣，已連續缺 6 場。

4395724.head: Quickley (hamstring) won't play Friday in Milwaukee, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4395724.story: This will be Quickley's first missed game of the season, and for now, he should be considered questionable for Monday's meeting with Memphis. Jamal Shead will likely start in his absence and Malachi Smith will have a chance to get into the rotation.
4395724.zh: 大腿後肌，週五對公鹿確定缺陣，週一對灰熊列 questionable。

4396818.head: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
4396818.story: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.
4396818.zh: 左肩旋轉肌撕裂手術完成，6 個月後重新評估，可能要到全明星賽後才回來。

4396993.head: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
4396993.story: Haliburton continues to recover from a left hamstring strain he picked up after Indiana's 110-102 loss to Milwaukee on Oct. 26. The Pacers star has missed the last five games, and his timetable to return is "uncertain", per head coach Rick Carlisle. Andrew Nembhard has been solid as the starting point guard with Haliburton sidelined, while Braden Smith and Quenton Jackson have provided extra depth in the backcourt. Indiana will get some reinforcements Saturday, however, as T.J. McConnell (hamstring) is expected to make his season debut in the NBA's Mexico City Game against the Nuggets.
4396993.zh: 左大腿後肌拉傷恢復順利，但還沒有回歸時間，已缺 5 場。

4397189.head: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
4397189.story: Smith left Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks after just seven minutes of play due to a left finger sprain and was initially deemed questionable for Sunday. His upgraded status is a good sign for Smith, who's been the starting center with Nic Claxton (hamstring) yet to play this season.
4397189.zh: 左手指扭傷，週日對七六人列 probable，應該會上場。

4397449.head: Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
4397449.story: Harkless is no longer a free agent after the Jazz declined his team option back in June. A defensive-minded wing, Harkless will likely play a prominent role for Detroit's G League affiliate in the early going.
4397449.zh: 跟活塞簽雙向合約，預計主要在發展聯盟出賽。

4431785.head: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.
4431785.story: Pippen is set for his fourth consecutive absence while dealing with a back issue. His next opportunity to return will arrive Monday in Toronto.
4431785.zh: 背傷，週五對雷霆確定缺陣，已連續第四場缺賽。

4432165.head: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432165.story: Suggs suffered the injury during Sunday's win over the Knicks when his right knee buckled following a layup attempt. Fortunately, further testing revealed no major structural damage, though the 25-year-old will miss at least two weeks before being re-evaluated. Anthony Black and Jase Richardson could see increased opportunities in Orlando's backcourt during Suggs' absence.
4432165.zh: 右膝輕度骨挫傷，兩週後重新評估。

4432170.head: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4432170.story: Jackson played through the groin issue in Wednesday's 117-116 loss to the Heat, but logged a season-low 13 minutes, suggesting the injury was bothering him. For now, Jackson should be considered questionable for Tuesday's game in Phoenix. Baba Miller will serve as the backup center with Jackson sidelined Sunday.
4432170.zh: 鼠蹊部傷，週日對鵜鶘不上場，之後以 questionable 看待。

4432171.head: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
4432171.story: Moody has been limited to individual court work, but team sources indicate he's ahead of Jimmy Butler (knee) in the rehabilitation process and is expected to return before the veteran forward. The 24-year-old still has several recovery checkpoints to complete, and Golden State has not established an official timetable. His eventual return would help replenish a Warriors wing rotation that will open the season without both Moody and Butler.
4432171.zh: 左髕骨肌腱斷裂（3 月），預計 12 月到 1 月之間回歸，目前只能個人訓練。

4432181.head: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
4432181.story: Strawther suffered the injury in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers. The 24-year-old has appeared in 172 regular-season games for the Nuggets since entering the league in 2023, averaging 7.1 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 16.2 minutes per contest. He was in line to compete for an expanded role during the 2026-27 campaign. While that may be the case once Strawther is cleared to suit up, Tyus Jones and potentially Ryan Nembhard are candidates to receive more minutes in the interim.
4432181.zh: 左膝扭傷，6 週後重新評估。

4432187.head: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
4432187.story: Beekman is set for an extended absence, with his re-evaluation timeline suggesting he could remain sidelined beyond the initial three-week window. The injury further limits Washington's backcourt depth, though Beekman's absence is unlikely to have a significant impact on standard fantasy leagues.
4432187.zh: 右肩鎖關節受傷，約 3 週後重新評估，可能缺更久。

4432573.head: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432573.story: Banchero left during Friday's loss against the Timberwolves due to an ankle injury, and follow-up tests have confirmed a high-ankle sprain for the fifth-year forward. With an extended absence expected, the Magic will have to rely more heavily on Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane offensively, and Tristan da Silva figures to be the top candidate to enter the Magic's starting lineup for as long as Banchero is sidelined.
4432573.zh: 右腳踝高位扭傷，預計缺陣 4 到 6 週。

4432586.head: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.
4432586.story: For now, fantasy managers can assume that he's week-to-week. He's not expected to crack the rotation upon his return.
4432586.zh: 腳傷，週一對快艇確定缺陣，沒有回歸時間，以週為單位觀察。

4432810.head: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
4432810.story: Stewart suffered a right knee bone bruise in Wednesday's loss to the Pacers and will hit the inactive list Thursday. His next opportunity to play will come Monday at Toronto. Quinten Post figures to see increased burn for as long as Stewart is sidelined.
4432810.zh: 右膝骨挫傷，週五對雷霆確定缺陣，下一次機會是週一對暴龍。

4432823.head: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
4432823.story: Williams will miss a third straight game due to lower-back spasms, leaving the door open for Micah Peavy, Kenrich Williams and Aday Mara to continue working in elevated roles Saturday. Williams' next opportunity to play will come Tuesday at Portland.
4432823.zh: 下背痙攣，週六對巫師確定缺陣，已連續缺 3 場，下一次機會是週二。

4432907.head: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
4432907.story: The forward underwent surgery Wednesday to address a fractured foot, and the Wizards hope Champagnie will be ready to return at some time around the All-Star break in February. The likes of Bilal Coulibaly, Tre Johnson and Bub Carrington will all be asked to help pick up the slack for the foreseeable future.
4432907.zh: 腳部骨折手術完成，預計缺陣數個月，球團希望全明星賽前後回來。

4433076.head: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
4433076.story: Sheppard required a full repair and is without a definitive timetable for a return to action. With Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) expected to miss at least two weeks, Quenton Jackson figures to see a significant uptick in playing time. Two-way player Braden Smith could also see increased action with the parent club.
4433076.zh: 左膝半月板撕裂手術完成，教練說要缺陣「好幾個月」。

4433134.head: Barnes (adductor) is listed as out for Friday's game against Milwaukee, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4433134.story: Barnes will miss his first game of the 2026-27 campaign Friday, and his next chance to suit up will come Monday in Memphis. With Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Kawhi Leonard (knee) sidelined as well, RJ Barrett, Ja'Kobe Walter, Jamal Shead and Collin Murray-Boyles are expected to be the Raptors' top offensive contributors, regardless of who starts.
4433134.zh: 內收肌傷，週五對公鹿缺陣，是本季第一場缺賽，下一次機會是週一對灰熊。

4433249.head: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.
4433249.story: Diabate's absence will leave Charlotte shorthanded in the frontcourt against the Celtics. Ryan Kalkbrenner could see additional opportunities at center, while other available big men may also absorb minutes. Diabate's next opportunity to play will come Monday against Cleveland.
4433249.zh: 股四頭肌傷，週五對塞爾提克確定缺陣，下一次機會是週一對騎士。

4433255.head: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
4433255.story: This is another massive blow to an Oklahoma City squad that's already set to be without Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) for most, if not all, of the season. With Holmgren sidelined, Kenrich Williams, Jaylin Williams and Aday Mara are all candidates to see increased playing time. Two-way player Brooks Barnhizer could also see more minutes.
4433255.zh: 髕骨肌腱小撕裂，已接受生物治療，至少缺 8 到 10 週。

4433287.head: Head coach Charles Lee said Miller (groin) will be re-evaluated over the weekend, and they expect to have more information by Monday, Steve Reed of The Associated Press reports.
4433287.story: Lee downplayed the groin issue after the game, saying he didn't see exactly when the injury occurred but noticed Miller started limping, and he asked for a sub after a couple of plays. He was ruled out after heading back to the locker room, and Tidjane Salaun started the second half for him. If Miller needs to miss additional time, Coby White and Naz Reid would be asked to step it up on offense, and there would be more minutes available for Salaun and Sion James.
4433287.zh: 鼠蹊部傷，週末重新評估，週一前會有更多消息。

4433621.head: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4433621.story: Duren suffered the hamstring injury in Friday's win over Miami and is set to miss an extended period. Paul Reed is expected to join the starting five and carries significant fantasy value until Duren returns. John Collins and Tolu Smith are also candidates to see a bump in minutes in Duren's stead.
4433621.zh: 右大腿後肌拉傷，兩週後重新評估。

4578893.head: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4578893.story: Nori did not provide a timetable for Krejci, but it's safe to say that he won't be back soon. His minutes figure to be divvied up amongst Chris Youngblood and Sidy Cissoko.
4578893.zh: 左腿骨折，沒有回歸時間，短期內不會回來。

4585618.head: Gilbert (knee) is out for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.
4585618.story: Gilbert's season debut will be delayed further as he continues to battle left knee inflammation, though he will likely be assigned to the G League once he's fully healthy.
4585618.zh: 左膝發炎，週六對籃網確定缺陣，本季首戰再延後。

4593803.head: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
4593803.story: Williams suffered the injury during Sunday's meeting with the Clippers and was taken off the court on a stretcher. It's unknown when the 25-year-old will be cleared to return, though the Thunder will presumably be overly cautious moving forward. Williams, who signed a five-year extension in July of 2025, has had a productive career, averaging 17.9 points, 4.6 rebounds, 4.4 assists and 1.3 steals over 30.9 minutes per contest. However, after playing at least 69 regular-season games in his first three years in the league, he has appeared in just 36 in the last two seasons combined. With the Thun
4593803.zh: 腓骨骨折與腳踝韌帶重建手術完成，賽季結束前會重新評估。

4594268.head: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
4594268.story: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. Edwards was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four appearances.
4594268.zh: 右膝關節鏡手術成功，球團沒給回歸時間，據報最多缺兩個月。

4594327.head: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.
4594327.story: Murray hasn't played since going down with an ankle injury on Oct. 25, so if he is cleared for Sunday's game, his minutes will likely be monitored. His return would likely push Precious Achiuwa back to the second unit.
4594327.zh: 腳踝傷（10/25 起），週日對熱火列 questionable，回來後上場時間可能受限。

4606840.head: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
4606840.story: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.
4606840.zh: ACL 撕裂手術完成，沒有回歸時間，通常需要一年左右。

4683688.head: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
4683688.story: Although there haven't been any negative reports regarding Lively's rehab progress, it doesn't appear he will be back in the lineup anytime soon. For now, the 22-year-old should be considered week-to-week. While Lively remains on the shelf, Daniel Gafford and Moussa Cisse should continue to handle most of the work at the five. Santi Aldama (knee) might also get involved in that area once he's cleared to return.
4683688.zh: 腳傷，週一對國王確定缺陣，沒有負面消息但短期內不會回來，以週為單位觀察。

4683692.head: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4683692.story: Wallace is expected to miss most, if not all, of the season. However, there's still a chance he will return late in the campaign after sustaining the shoulder injury in Sunday's win over the Clippers. With Jalen Williams (leg) also set to be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Alex Caruso (ankle) should see significant playing time once cleared to return. In the meantime, Jared McCain, Bennett Stirtz and Josh Dix are expected to see increased burn.
4683692.zh: 左肩盂唇撕裂手術完成，本季大部分時間會缺陣，賽季結束前重新評估。

4683747.head: Tyson (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
4683747.story: Tyson continues to recover from a sprained right ankle, and he'll miss the second leg of this back-to-back set after not playing Friday against Philadelphia. His next chance to play will come Monday at Charlotte. This means Mario Hezonja, Tyrese Proctor and Meleek Thomas could be in line for more playing time as long as Tyson remains out.
4683747.zh: 右腳踝扭傷，週六對尼克確定缺陣，下一次機會是週一對黃蜂。

4701232.head: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4701232.story: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.
4701232.zh: 左肩盂唇撕裂手術完成，將缺陣一段長時間。

4712863.head: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4712863.story: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
4712863.zh: 左腳骨折手術完成，3 到 4 個月後重新評估。

4870562.head: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.
4870562.story: Nurse added that the team is "pretty positive" that Barlow's back is getting better, though he's still going to have to wait some more time before being cleared. The big man has yet to make his season debut due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, and he isn't expected to return until mid-November at the earliest.
4870562.zh: 背傷，教練說還需要 10 到 12 天才能歸隊，本季還沒出賽。

4871141.head: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4871141.story: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.
4871141.zh: 右腳阿基里斯腱斷裂，本季報銷。

4873201.head: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.
4873201.story: Newell missed Friday's game against the Wizards and will also miss Saturday's contest. Newell has a secondary role in the rotation, so his absence shouldn't matter much from a fantasy perspective. His next chance to suit up will come against the Lakers on Monday.
4873201.zh: 腳趾傷，週六對籃網確定缺陣，連續缺兩場，對 fantasy 影響不大。

4898371.head: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4898371.story: Raynaud's absence is expected to extend into mid-November due to a right patellar subluxation. With Dylan Cardwell (calf) set to miss at least one more week, Precious Achiuwa, Jonathan Mogbo and De'Andre Hunter are candidates for increased minutes in the frontcourt.
4898371.zh: 右髕骨半脫位，約兩週後重新評估，預計缺陣到 11 月中。

4914336.head: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4914336.story: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.
4914336.zh: 膝蓋半月板撕裂，預計缺陣六個月，可能要到全明星賽後才回歸。

4997537.head: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.
4997537.story: The Wizards announced on Oct. 1 that Vukcevic would be sidelined for at least a month. However, there haven't been any definitive updates regarding when he will be able to get back on the floor. In the meantime, Deandre Ayton should see more minutes off the bench.
4997537.zh: 髖部傷，週一對魔術確定缺陣，球團說至少缺一個月，還沒有新消息。

5061575.head: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.
5061575.story: Knueppel re-aggravated his left hamstring strain in his season debut Wednesday against Brooklyn. The Hornets haven't yet indicated the sharpshooter is facing a multi-week absence, but they'll likely proceed with caution. Grayson Allen is back in the mix as a high-end fantasy streaming option for as long as Knueppel is out.
5061575.zh: 左大腿後肌拉傷復發，週五對塞爾提克缺陣，球團還沒說明缺多久。

5061589.head: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
5061589.story: Missi has been sidelined since picking up his injury Oct. 23. He remains without a timetable to return.
5061589.zh: 左膝骨挫傷（10/23 起），沒有回歸時間，以週為單位觀察。

5061603.head: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.
5061603.story: Sorber remains in recovery mode due to knee surgery. Until the Thunder update his timetable for a return, Sorber can be deemed week-to-week.
5061603.zh: 膝蓋手術後復健中，週三對騎士確定缺陣，以週為單位觀察。

5101761.head: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5101761.story: Brown logged his fifth consecutive double-digit scoring performance Saturday. However, his efforts weren't enough to help the Nets hold off a late Hawks comeback and earn their third win of the 2026-27 campaign. Head coach Jordi Fernandez mentioned after the game that the rookie won't suit up Sunday versus the Mavericks, the second game of a back-to-back. Without Brown in the lineup, Terance Mann should see more minutes off the bench. Keon Ellis, who didn't get on the floor versus Atlanta, might also get involved.
5101761.zh: 週日對獨行俠不上場（背靠背），週六剛拿 18 分。

5101845.head: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
5101845.story: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.
5101845.zh: ACL 和半月板撕裂後復健中，還沒獲准進行籃球活動，球團會非常保守。

5105462.head: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5105462.story: Saunders is still on the mend from a torn right ACL that he suffered during his final year at BYU. However, he has been cleared for on-court activities and will be allowed to practice with the Grizzlies now that he's officially signed with the team.
5105462.zh: 跟灰熊簽雙向合約，右膝 ACL 撕裂後已獲准上場練習。

5105555.head: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.
5105555.story: Awaka missed Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks due to a sprained left MCL, and he's now in danger of missing a second consecutive outing with the ailment. Zach Collins (illness) has already been ruled out Sunday, leaving Noa Essengue, Leonard Miller and Patrick Williams as candidates to see more opportunities off Chicago's bench.
5105555.zh: 左膝 MCL 扭傷，週日對七六人列 questionable，可能連續缺兩場。

5105571.head: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
5105571.story: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
5105571.zh: 右膝 ACL 撕裂，本季報銷。

5105637.head: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.
5105637.story: Bona will miss his second straight game Sunday, which should again result in some extra minutes for Jabari Walker. Bona's next chance to play will come Tuesday against the Celtics.
5105637.zh: 背傷，週日對公牛確定缺陣，連續缺兩場，下一次機會是週二對塞爾提克。

5107251.head: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
5107251.story: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.
5107251.zh: 左腳踝手術後復健中，約一個月後才能回場。

5107818.head: Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.
5107818.story: Jones was one of four Phoenix players who scored at least 15 points, and he also led the team in rebounds and blocks while ranking second in steals. This was Jones' second double-double in four Summer League contests, and the third time he has surpassed the 15-point threshold.
5107818.zh: 夏季聯盟拿 18 分 10 籃板（舊新聞），目前沒有新的傷況消息。

5108024.head: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
5108024.story: Niederhauser remains unlikely to play a meaningful role in the short term following a seven-month recovery from foot surgery. The 23-year-old might instead make a phased return to action, possibly seeing limited minutes at some point in upcoming weeks and making some appearances in the G League. Last season, he averaged 4.3 points, 2.9 rebounds and 0.3 assists per regular-season game during his rookie year.
5108024.zh: 腳部手術後已從發展聯盟召回，短期內不會有重要角色。

5148538.head: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.
5148538.story: Biberovic has been battling inflammation in his right heel, preventing him from making his NBA debut. While the rookie should be considered week-to-week, he likely has a way to go before earning a meaningful role in Dallas even when he's cleared to suit up.
5148538.zh: 右腳跟發炎，週一對國王確定缺陣，還沒 NBA 首戰，以週為單位觀察。

5157066.head: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
5157066.story: The Pacers have been pretty quiet regarding Furphy's ACL recovery since the offseason, but it's encouraging to hear some form of progress as the forward begins to ramp up his activity. Although Furphy still lacks a firm timetable for a return and is likely to be brought back slowly, it appears a season debut before the start of the new calendar year is in the cards.
5157066.zh: ACL 復健中，已開始跟發展聯盟球隊練球。

5175643.head: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
5175643.story: Brooklyn's decision keeps Demin under contract through the 2027-28 campaign as the organization continues investing in its young backcourt. The move provides additional long-term stability but doesn't directly impact his immediate fantasy outlook. Demin is currently dealing with a right leg bone bruise and is scheduled to be re-evaluated in one week.
5175643.zh: 籃網執行第三年球隊選擇權，目前右小腿骨挫傷，等待重新評估。

5214637.head: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
5214637.story: Penda suffered the hamstring tear in Friday's 136-115 preseason win over the Heat. It's unknown how long the injury will keep the 21-year-old off the floor. However, since it's a different injury than the one he suffered in the same hamstring during training camp, the team may take a cautious approach regarding his return. Penda, the No. 32 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, averaged 3.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and 1.2 assists over 12.8 minutes per outing in 59 regular-season games in 2025-26. While he's not expected to be a mainstay in the rotation throughout the 2026-27 campaign, his absence c
5214637.zh: 右大腿後肌部分撕裂，缺陣時間未定。

5279129.head: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.
5279129.story: De Larrea continues to miss time with a right knee strain, and it's not clear at this time where he's at in his rehab. He can be considered week-to-week until further notice.
5279129.zh: 右膝拉傷，週五對爵士確定缺陣，以週為單位觀察。

5279133.head: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.
5279133.story: Beringer broke his nose during Friday's win over the Pelicans, so he might need to miss Sunday's game. If he's out, Trey Lyles would have the chance for some extended run.
5279133.zh: 鼻骨骨折，週日對爵士列 questionable。
